values.note: Electric only $34, water/electric $39, full hookup $44; tent (no utilities) $29. Weekly $141-225, monthly $282-675, seasonal $562-1,800 by site type.

fees.source: City of Warroad Campground Rates PDF, Rev. 2025 ('Night $44 / $39 / $34 / $29' for Full Hookup / Water & Electric / Electric Only / No Hookup), linked from warroadmn.org/parks-rec as '2025 Campground Rates', read 2026-11-20

values.note: Call 218-386-1004 or mail/email the city's reservation form (deposit required); the office is not staffed all business hours, so calls are returned within 1-2 business days.

booking.source: warroadmn.org Campground Reservations ('Campground Reservations may be made by calling 218-386-1004'; 'Calls will be returned within 1 to 2 business days') + reservation form in the rates PDF ('Deposit Pd by'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Open May 1 through Columbus Day (second Monday of October).

season.source: warroadmn.org Campground Reservations + rates PDF ('Warroad Campground is open May 1st - Columbus Day'), read 2026-11-20

hookups.source: City rates PDF and map (Full Hookup / Water & Electric / Electric Only; 'All other sites are full hook-ups') + Explore Minnesota capture 2026-02-07 ('50 amp', 'Electric', 'Sewer', 'Water')

facilities.source: City map legend ('D - Dump Station', 'R - Restrooms/Showers') + Explore Minnesota capture 2026-02-07 ('Flush toilets in campground', 'Hot showers in campground', 'Sanitary dump station')

note: City of Warroad campground at the mouth of the Warroad River on Lake of the Woods, in sections around the city beach, boat launch and outdoor sand-bottom pool. Some sites go to monthly and seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: City parks page, 2025 rates PDF, site map and reservation page read via headless browser (+ Explore Minnesota Wayback 2026-02): $34-44/night by hookup (tent $29), seasonal/monthly rates, book by phone, open May 1-Columbus Day, 50A/W/S, showers, dump. Lakeview kept. Website to city page.
flags: WEBSITE: https://visitwarroad.com/city-of-warroad-campground/ (chamber listing) -> https://www.warroadmn.org/parks-rec (city page with rates and map). Phone 218-386-1004 confirmed (city 'Campground Office').

WATERFRONT lakeview kept: on the city map the south block's sites 1-14 run along Lake St, with the street, the beach strip and the boat-trailer lot between them and Lake of the Woods; on Esri imagery that east row (~48.9068,-95.3008) is ~55-65 m from the water across the road. The north section's sites 130-142 ring a backwater pond under continuous tree canopy (~48.9095,-95.3045), and the north electric strip near Taylor Rd (~48.9090,-95.3017) is ~70-100 m from open water across marsh and a tree belt. No site is within ~50 m over open ground.
SITES: the map shows numbered sites up to 165 plus W/E/T series; Explore Minnesota (2026-02 capture) says '172' RV sites, '24' tent and '182' total (internally inconsistent). Count left unset.

LONG-STAY (local): weekly, monthly and seasonal rates for every site type; nightly share not published. Explore Minnesota lists 'Daily site rental' and 'Seasonal site rental'. Google Maps 4.4 from 57 reviews.
